scripts.project: npm run profile:sync && mkdir -p App/Resources/web && xcodegen generate --spec project.yml
scripts.prebuild: npm run project && npm run sync:web
scripts.build: xcodebuild -project AuroraPrimeOffice.xcodeproj -scheme AuroraPrimeOffice -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO AURORA_SKIP_WEB_SYNC=1 build
